checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Matte black insulated bottle remains recognizable
must.why: Same matte black bottle, same room and table in all frames. The cap changes from the original vented top to a loop-handle lid.

must.item: Bottle visibly turns slowly through roughly a quarter turn, not merely sliding or enlarging
must.why: The only sign of rotation is the cap loop swinging around. The body is a plain cylinder with no features. The bottle also drifts left and grows noticeably in the middle frames, then shrinks back, so it reads partly as sliding and scaling.

must.item: Bottle stays upright without melting, bending or changing proportions
must.why: It stays upright and does not melt. However, it looks wider and taller at 2.4 s and 4.2 s, so the proportions are not stable. The cap geometry is also reinvented.

must.item: Camera and wooden table remain stationary
must.why: The background, window, chair and table grain look fixed. Only the bottle moves.
Frames are square, and the clip is 6 s per the frame timestamps. The reply says it is 640x640 with no sound. I could not check the audio track from stills.

faults.what: The bottle drifts left and appears to scale up by about 10% mid-clip, then returns. The turn reads as a move toward the camera.
The cap changes from the original vented top to a loop handle and flip lid. This is an invented detail and it changes shape between frames.
The rotation is hard to see because the body is featureless. Only the handle shows the turn.
The bottle base and shadow shift position across frames.

summary: The clip keeps the bottle, the room and a still camera, but the bottle drifts and swells mid-clip, the cap is reinvented as a loop handle, and the quarter turn is barely readable.
